businesses.business: Healthcare workforce and patient experience software

offering_description.value: Sells cloud software and related research services that help hospitals and health systems manage clinical staff credentialing, training, scheduling and engagement, and measure patient experience. Sold mainly by direct sales to healthcare organizations, with subscriptions and service fees.

primary_products.value: credentialing and compliance software; learning management software; staff scheduling software; workforce engagement surveys; patient experience survey tools

primary_services.value: managed services; consulting; survey research; continuing education content

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, behavioral health providers, post-acute care and ambulatory care organizations

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospitals and health systems; post-acute care; behavioral health

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual or multi-year software access fees paid by healthcare organizations; service fees: implementation, consulting, managed services and survey administration; project or contract: custom research studies and benchmarking projects for healthcare clients
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud applications for workforce and patient experience, sold to healthcare providers; service provider: consulting, managed services and research for hospitals and health systems

geography_served.value: US national: hospitals and health systems across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: workforce software, learning content, patient experience surveys and research services for healthcare

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to hospitals and health system executives

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA patient data privacy rules and healthcare credentialing and accreditation standards, such as Joint Commission requirements
